messages.subject: error fitting a model
parts:
Hi!

I encountered a error fitting a model. Could anyone help me?

#simulation
simmodel<-'
factor1 =~ .5*item1 + .5*item2 + .5*item3 + .5*item4
factor2 =~ .5*item1 + .5*item2
factor3 =~ .5*item3 + .5*item4
item1 | t1
item2 | t1
item3 | t1
item4 | t1
factor1 ~~ 0*factor2
factor1 ~~ 0*factor3
factor2 ~~ 0*factor3
'
dat<-simulateData(model=simmodel,return.type="data.frame",std.lv=TRUE,sample.nobs=10000)
 
#analysis
anamodel<-'
factor1 =~ item1 + item2 + item3 + item4
factor2 =~ item1 + item2
factor3 =~ item3 + item4
'
fit<-cfa(model=anamodel,dat,ordered=c("item1","item2","item3","item4"),estimator="WLSMV",std.lv=TRUE,orthogonal="TRUE")
Aviso en estimateVCOV(lavaanModel, samplestats = lavaanSampleStats, options = lavaanOptions,  :
lavaan WARNING: could not compute standard errors!

The error disappears by fixing the loadings to be equal on factors 2 and 3

Thanks,

Binibin.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: error fitting a model
parts:
On 01/26/2014 06:05 PM, cybe...@gmail.com wrote:

> #analysis
> anamodel<-'
> factor1 =~ item1 + item2 + item3 + item4
> factor2 =~ item1 + item2
> factor3 =~ item3 + item4
> '

You have 12 free parameters (8 factor loadings, 4 thresholds), but only
10 datapoints (4*3/2 = 6 correlations and 4 thresholds). Estimation may
work fine, but inference (standard errors, fit statistic) will break down.

In short: you need more items.

lavaan should give you a warning about this (but it does not appear to
do so); will fix this.

Yves.
